segments.text: Place the welding wire.
Now we replace the 1 millimeter welding wire with a 1.2 millimeter welding wire.
segments.zh: 现在我们把 1 毫米焊丝换成 1.2 毫米焊丝。

segments.text: Open the door of the wire feeder, unscrew the cap, and remove the sleeve.
segments.zh: 打开送丝机的门，拧下盖子，取下套筒。

segments.text: Open the two tensioners.
Rotate the wire spool clockwise to remove the wire from the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 顺时针转动焊丝盘，把焊丝从送丝驱动器中退出来。

segments.text: Take out the wire spool.
Bend the wire end and store it in the hole of the wire spool.
segments.zh: 把焊丝末端弯折，并把它收在焊丝盘的孔里。

segments.text: Remove the screws.
Remove the current drive rolls.
Remove the screws above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 拆下送丝驱动器上方的螺丝。

segments.text: Take out the drive rolls stored above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 取出存放在送丝驱动器上方的送丝轮。

segments.text: Ensure that the size on the outer side of the drive rolls
segments.zh: 确保送丝轮外侧标注的尺寸

segments.text: matches the welding wire's diameter.
Install the new pair of drive rolls.
Install the screws back.
Store the other pair of drive rolls above the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把另一对送丝轮存放在送丝驱动器上方。

segments.text: Replace the 0.8 slash 1.0 nozzle with a provided 1.2 slash 1.6 wire feeding
segments.zh: 把 0.8/1.0 的喷嘴换成随附的 1.2/1.6 送丝

segments.text: nozzle.
Install the new wire spool.
Install the sleeve back.
Install the cap back.
Take out the wire end.
Cut off the bent end of the wire.
Thread the wire into the wire feeding driver.
segments.zh: 把焊丝穿入送丝驱动器。

segments.text: Press the wire slightly to make it pass through.
segments.zh: 轻轻按压焊丝，让它穿过去。

segments.text: Close the tensioners.
Rotate the tensioners knobs to adjust the wire feed tension.
segments.zh: 转动压紧器的旋钮来调节送丝张力。

segments.text: Press and hold the feed button on the wire feeder
segments.zh: 按住送丝机上的送丝按钮，

segments.text: until the wire extends out from the nozzle.
segments.zh: 直到焊丝从喷嘴伸出来。
